== Contributing ==
* Create an account, then edit any page. New pages can be created once your account is a couple of days old.
* Keep pages factual and tested on Fiordland. If a fix comes from the [https://wiki.archlinux.org Arch Wiki], link to it.
* See [[Fiordland Wiki:Style guide]] before writing a new page.
